Chief_Complaint.content: Patient presents with a left-sided headache that began upon waking today.
Chief_Complaint.source_text: Has had headache upon waking from this morning on left side  head- pain woke pt up at 530am

History_of_Present_Illness.content: The headache began at about 5:30 AM and woke the patient from sleep.
Headache is still present at the time of consultation.
Patient has a history of less-severe frontal headaches in the past.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Has had hx of headaches less severe and in front of the head in past

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient currently has some sensitivity to bright lights (photophobia).
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Some sensitivity to bright lights now

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient has no nausea at present.
Patient felt dizzy this morning but is not dizzy now.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Felt dizzy this morning,  but not now

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Headache improves when the patient is lying down.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Headache is better  when lying down.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Paracetamol taken by the patient did not relieve the headache.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Pt has taken paracetamol- not helped

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient reports ongoing work stress and late nights for a few months.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Work is stressful, late nights at work- ongoing for a few months.

Past_Medical_History.content: Patient has a 2-year history of anxiety.
Otherwise patient reports no significant past medical history.

Medications.content: Patient has taken paracetamol for the current headache.
Medications.source_text: Pt has taken paracetamol- not helped

Adverse_Drug_Reactions_and_Allergies.content: Patient has no known drug allergies.

Family_History.content: There is no family history of migraines.

Social_and_Family_History.content: Patient has a cat at home.
Patient engages in good exercise and maintains a reasonable diet.
Patient describes work as stressful with late nights over several months.
Social_and_Family_History.source_text: Work is stressful, late nights at work- ongoing for a few months.

Assessment.content: Clinical impression is a tension-type headache with possible migraine.

Plan_of_Care.content: Start ibuprofen as first-line treatment per SIGN 2018 migraine guidelines.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Plan: for ibuprofen first line as per SIGN 2018 migraine guidelines

Plan_of_Care.content: Advise hydration of 1.5–2 litres of water daily.
Recommend 7–8 hours of sleep each night.
Consider taking time off work and self-certify for a few days.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Consider time off- to self certify for a few days to see if this helps

Follow_up_Information.content: Patient to be reviewed in one week.
If any red-flag headache symptoms occur, patient should ring back sooner.
Follow_up_Information.source_text: If any red flag symptoms as per www.patient.co.uk/ headache, to ring back sooner
